post.summary: Send a message to a channel
post.description: App Bot: DM-only (channel_type=1) and requires friend relationship. User Bot: DM + group + thread (requires membership).

on_behalf_of.description: OBO: send as this user persona; requires an active OBO grant + channel scope

payload.description: message payload (content, type, mention, etc.). Pass via --data (object, not a flag).

client_msg_no.description: client message number echoed back by the server

message_id.description: int64; stringify it when passing to message.edit

post.description: Only the original sender bot may edit. App Bot: DM only. Raw mode requires non-blank content_edit and omits template_ref. Registry mode requires template_ref, state, data, and positive card_seq, and omits content_edit entirely, including empty or null values. Supply the template_ref and data objects through --data. A positive message_seq must match message_id.
post.x-octo-body-variants-hint: Use exactly one mode: raw requires non-blank content_edit and omits template_ref; Registry requires template_ref, state, data, and positive card_seq and omits content_edit entirely. Even empty or null content_edit conflicts with Registry mode.

message_id.description: ID of the message to edit; pass its integer ID as a string.

message_seq.description: Optional positive target sequence; backend checks it against message_id. Omitted or 0 resolves server-side.

content_edit.description: Raw edit mode only: non-blank replacement payload encoded as a JSON string; omit entirely in Registry mode.

template_ref.description: Registry edit template reference; omit content_edit.

state.description: State input for Registry template rendering.

data.description: Data input for Registry template rendering.

card_seq.description: Positive sequence for this Registry card update; the backend enforces sequence and revision rules.

transient.description: Mark the Registry-rendered update as a transient progress frame.

post.description: App Bot: DM only. User Bot: DM + group + thread (membership required).

start_message_seq.description: Beginning sequence for the requested history window.

end_message_seq.description: Ending sequence for the requested history window.

limit.description: Maximum messages to return; defaults to 50 and is capped at 200.

post.description: Full-text message search. With --chat-id: pure messages within that channel (payload.type in [1,11,14]). Without --chat-id: the CLI routes to cross-channel _search_global_messages, which is a MIXED feed (messages + files), so cross-channel results may include file hits. --on-behalf-of searches as that user (User Bot only, requires an active OBO grant). Requires a User Bot (bf_) or user API key (uk_) token; App Bot (app_) tokens are rejected.

channel_id.description: channel id to scope the search to; omit to search across all reachable channels (cross-channel mixed feed)

sort.description: sort order; relevance requires a non-empty keyword

filters.description: extra filters (sender_ids, member_uids, channel_ids, channel_types, content_types, sent_at_from, sent_at_to, ...). Pass via --data.

on_behalf_of.description: OBO: search as this user persona; requires an active OBO grant (User Bot only)

post.description: Mixed message+file search (payload.type in [1,8,11,14]; empty keyword also matches media). With --chat-id: within that channel. Without --chat-id: the CLI routes to cross-channel _search_global_messages. --on-behalf-of searches as that user (User Bot only). Requires a User Bot (bf_) or user API key (uk_) token; App Bot (app_) tokens are rejected.

channel_id.description: channel id to scope the search to; omit to search across all reachable channels

sort.description: sort order; relevance requires a non-empty keyword

filters.description: extra filters (sender_ids, member_uids, channel_ids, channel_types, content_types, sent_at_from, sent_at_to, ...). Pass via --data.

on_behalf_of.description: OBO: search as this user persona; requires an active OBO grant (User Bot only)

post.description: File search (payload.type=8). With --chat-id: within that channel. Without --chat-id: the CLI routes to cross-channel _search_global_files. --on-behalf-of searches as that user (User Bot only). Requires a User Bot (bf_) or user API key (uk_) token; App Bot (app_) tokens are rejected.

channel_id.description: channel id to scope the search to; omit to search files across all reachable channels

sort.description: sort order; relevance requires a non-empty keyword

filters.description: extra filters (file_exts, file_size_min, file_size_max, sender_ids, ...). Pass via --data.

on_behalf_of.description: OBO: search as this user persona; requires an active OBO grant (User Bot only)

post.description: Media search (payload.type in [2,5]). --chat-id is REQUIRED (no cross-channel media endpoint); the backend rejects requests without a channel_id. keyword must be empty (the backend rejects a non-empty keyword). --on-behalf-of searches as that user (User Bot only). Requires a User Bot (bf_) or user API key (uk_) token; App Bot (app_) tokens are rejected.

channel_id.description: REQUIRED. channel id to search media in (no cross-channel media endpoint)

filters.description: extra filters (sender_ids, content_types, sent_at_from, sent_at_to, ...). Pass via --data.

on_behalf_of.description: OBO: search as this user persona; requires an active OBO grant (User Bot only)

post.summary: Fetch the context window around an anchor message (in-channel only)
post.description: Locates the context window (messages before/after) around an anchor message. --chat-id is REQUIRED (a locate needs a single-channel anchor); the backend rejects requests without a channel_id. No pagination. --on-behalf-of searches as that user (User Bot only). Requires a User Bot (bf_) or user API key (uk_) token; App Bot (app_) tokens are rejected.

channel_id.description: REQUIRED. channel id containing the anchor message

anchor_message_id.description: REQUIRED. the message id to center the context window on

on_behalf_of.description: OBO: search as this user persona; requires an active OBO grant (User Bot only)

post.description: Cross-channel-only aggregated overview (L1): returns which groups/threads/DMs matched a keyword, not individual messages. Use it as the first level of a two-step search (find matching channels, then pull messages per channel with `message search`/`message search all`). --chat-id is not supported (cross-channel only). --on-behalf-of searches as that user (User Bot only). Requires a User Bot (bf_) or user API key (uk_) token; App Bot (app_) tokens are rejected.

filters.description: extra filters (channel_types, member_uids, sent_at_from, sent_at_to, ...). Pass via --data.

on_behalf_of.description: OBO: search as this user persona; requires an active OBO grant (User Bot only)
